_why: loop-gate check 15 reported NOT-ESTABLISHED (no-config) for OagEventSource on every cycle, which per EXP-ROC-003's own scoring trap is indistinguishable from a check that works. This establishes it against a real, reachable build identity rather than leaving the question unanswerable.
_what_it_measures: The ADMIN-CONSOLE SPA job in DEV, and nothing else. `infra/scripts/deploy-admin.sh` writes dist/build-info.json with VITE_BUILD_SHA=github.sha, uploaded to the OAC-only bucket oag-admin-site-dev and served through CloudFront. Verified live 2026-08-27: sha db1cd99a6a1c5791fca127b2e6fd0a43a2674f83, builtAt 2026-08-27T08:31:27.124Z.
_what_it_does_NOT_measure_read_this_befo: It is NOT the ECS ingest lane. That lane is the ONLY live writer of the real feed, it is egress-only and deliberately serves no HTTP, and the solution architect RULED (delta-079) against contorting it into serving HTTP so this checker could reach it. Whether the ECS service ADOPTED a revision is DEFECT-OAG-144, keyed on the task-def BUILD_SHA env var inside the deploy job. Neither check substitutes for the other.
It is NOT the Lambda tier. flight-feed-api's Function URL is IAM-authorized and returns 403 to an unsigned request; this checker curls unsigned, so it cannot read it.
It is NOT prod. The admin console SPA job runs in the dev stage only.

CRUCIALLY, it would NOT have caught the 2026-08-27 failure it was registered during: infra.yml went sandbox/dev/acceptance-dev/admin-console-dev GREEN and then FAILED at the shared Aerobus hub audit, leaving prod-shared and prod SKIPPED. This endpoint reported the new sha correctly while prod never received it. So a `current` verdict here means 'the chain reached the admin-console job', NOT 'the chain finished'. A skipped job runs no steps (DEF-ROC-086) and this check is blind to it.
_therefore: Treat `current` as a NARROW pass and never as evidence that a deploy completed. Its real value is the failure it CAN see: a chain that stopped BEFORE admin-console-dev, or a push that triggered no run at all, both of which leave this sha behind trunk while item events keep reporting deploys as intentions.
